title: Welcome to Nexus Launcher
summary: The Nexus Launcher is now available! Add your NexusForever server in the Community tab, configure your game path in Settings, and click PLAY to get started.

title: NexusForever Emulator
summary: NexusForever is an open-source server emulator for WildStar. Visit the GitHub repository to learn how to set up your own server.

title: Getting Started
summary:
1. Add your server in the Community tab.
2. Set your WildStar game path in Settings.
3. Click PLAY — the launcher will connect you automatically.

title: More Information
summary: For more details, visit the official NexusForever GitHub repository or join the community forums.
